propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.max-entries
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of normalized entries returned in a single activity-stream page after merging and sorting all sources.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.max-scheduled-task-runs
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent {@code @Scheduled} task executions retained for the {@code SCHEDULED} entries in the activity stream.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.n-plus-one-threshold
propertySuggestions.description: Number of identical normalized SELECT statements correlated to a single request above which an N+1 hint is surfaced in the per-request profile.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.buffer-max-entries
propertySuggestions.description: Capacity of both the in-memory hot read cache (entries visible immediately, even before their scheduled flush) and the pending-flush queue (entries awaiting their first durable write).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.capture-interval
propertySuggestions.description: How often the capture coordinator polls the merged Live Activity feed for new entries.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.data-source-mode
propertySuggestions.description: Where the durable store gets its JDBC connections from: {@code SHARED} reuses the host application's own {@code DataSource} bean (the same one BootUI's SQL Trace panel may already be tracing), {@code DEDICATED} opens a small, non-pooled connection of BootUI's own using the {@code dedicated-*} properties below.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-driver-class-name
propertySuggestions.description: Optional explicit JDBC driver class to load for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}; blank lets the driver auto-register itself from the classpath (the usual case for a modern JDBC 4+ driver).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-jdbc-url
propertySuggestions.description: JDBC URL for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}, otherwise ignored.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-password
propertySuggestions.description: Password for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}, otherwise ignored.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-username
propertySuggestions.description: Username for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}, otherwise ignored.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether captured Live Activity entries are also durably persisted, in addition to today's in-memory-only default. Disabled by default: no background thread, connection or bean beyond what already exists is created while this is {@code false}.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.flush-interval
propertySuggestions.description: How often buffered entries are flushed to durable storage.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.instance-id
propertySuggestions.description: The multi-tenant partition key this running instance writes and reads its rows under, so several BootUI instances can safely share one database table. Defaults to the {@code HOSTNAME} environment variable (a natural, stable identity for a container/Kubernetes pod) or else a generated {@code <app-name>-<random>} id, computed once at startup.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.retention
propertySuggestions.description: How long persisted rows are kept before being pruned; entries older than this are eligible for deletion on this instance's own next prune pass. Only this instance's own rows are ever pruned.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.persistence.table-name
propertySuggestions.description: Table name every BootUI instance pointed at the same database shares. Must be a plain SQL identifier; created automatically on first use if it does not already exist.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.activity.request-slow-threshold-ms
propertySuggestions.description: Threshold in milliseconds above which a request is flagged as slow in the stream and KPI strip.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.ai.max-recent-chats
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent chat completions surfaced by the AI panel.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.ai.show-content-capture-banner
propertySuggestions.description: When true, BootUI surfaces a banner explaining that prompt/completion content is not captured by default.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.ai.token-series-minutes
propertySuggestions.description: Number of minutes retained in the per-minute token-usage series.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.allow-non-localhost
propertySuggestions.description: Allow non-loopback requests (explicit opt-out of safety).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.allowed-hosts
propertySuggestions.description: Additional Host header values accepted by the loopback safety filter, beyond the built-in loopback names (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1). Used to defend against DNS-rebinding attacks while still allowing custom local hostnames.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.api-path
propertySuggestions.description: Internal API base path. Defaults to {@code bootui.path + "/api"}. Override only when the API must be served at a different sub-path from the UI (rare).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.authentication.token
propertySuggestions.description: Optional bearer token for non-loopback API access. When blank, BootUI generates one at startup.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cache.activity-capture-enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether BootUI wraps {@code CacheManager} beans to capture hit/miss/put/evict/clear accesses into the Live Activity panel's {@code CACHE} event type. Cache keys are always hashed, never recorded raw, regardless of value exposure. When {@code false}, no {@code CacheManager} is wrapped and cache accesses never appear in Live Activity.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cache.activity-max-events
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent cache accesses retained in the in-memory ring buffer feeding Live Activity.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cache.clear-enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Allow BootUI to clear application caches from the Cache panel.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.allow-raw-reveal
propertySuggestions.description: Allow the opt-in raw-event reveal endpoint. When {@code false}, the endpoint returns HTTP 404 even on the loopback interface.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Enable the Copilot panel. AUTO activates only when the session-state directory exists.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.max-events-per-session
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of activity events retained per session in memory.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.max-parsed-sessions
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent session files parsed and retained in memory.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.max-sessions
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent sessions returned to the session explorer.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.session-state-dir
propertySuggestions.description: Override the directory scanned for Copilot CLI session-state directories. When {@code null}, defaults to {@code ${user.home}/.copilot/session-state}.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.claude-code.stream-debounce
propertySuggestions.description: Debounce window applied to file-system events before refreshing parsed sessions and notifying SSE subscribers.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cli.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether {@code /bootui/api/cli} answers. {@code true} by default; {@code false} returns 503.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cli.execution-timeout
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum wall-clock duration of one command-line tool invocation; default 30 seconds (504 on expiry).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cli.max-concurrent-calls
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of concurrent command-line tool invocations; default 20. Excess calls get a 429.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.cli.max-results
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of items returned by paginated read tools in a single call. Mirrors {@code bootui.mcp.max-results} but is tracked separately so command-line traffic can be tuned without changing what agents see.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.allow-raw-reveal
propertySuggestions.description: Allow the opt-in raw-event reveal endpoint. When {@code false}, the endpoint returns HTTP 404 even on the loopback interface.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Enable the Copilot panel. AUTO activates only when the session-state directory exists.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.max-events-per-session
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of activity events retained per session in memory.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.max-parsed-sessions
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent session files parsed and retained in memory.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.max-sessions
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent sessions returned to the session explorer.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.session-state-dir
propertySuggestions.description: Override the directory scanned for Copilot CLI session-state directories. When {@code null}, defaults to {@code ${user.home}/.copilot/session-state}.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.copilot.stream-debounce
propertySuggestions.description: Debounce window applied to file-system events before refreshing parsed sessions and notifying SSE subscribers.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.dev-services.log-tail-bytes
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum bytes returned by a single Dev Services log request.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.dev-services.restart-enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Allow BootUI to restart Testcontainers-backed services.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.disabled-profiles
propertySuggestions.description: Profiles that force BootUI off, even when enabled by other rules.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.email.dev-trap
propertySuggestions.description: When {@code true}, captured messages are recorded but never actually handed to the real mail transport (like MailDev/GreenMail's dev-trap behavior). Off by default, so BootUI never silently swallows application mail.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.email.mask-content
propertySuggestions.description: When {@code true}, captured recipients/subject/body are masked unless {@code bootui.expose- values=FULL}, matching BootUI's config/secret masking. Off by default: email content is ordinary application data (not credentials), so it is revealed by default — like Laravel Telescope's Mail watcher and like BootUI's own HTTP Exchanges/SQL Trace panels — decoupled from the global secret-exposure flag so reading a test email never requires exposing unrelated production secrets (or vice versa).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.email.max-body-length
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of characters retained per captured text/HTML body; a longer body is truncated at capture time. Bounds memory for a single oversized message the same way {@link #maxEntries} bounds the number of retained messages (attachment content is never captured in the first place, so only bodies need this cap).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.email.max-entries
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of captured messages retained; the oldest is evicted once full.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Enable BootUI. AUTO activates only in dev/local contexts.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.enabled-profiles
propertySuggestions.description: Profiles that trigger auto-activation.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.exceptions.max-groups
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of distinct exception groups retained by the Exceptions panel. When the limit is reached the group with the oldest most-recent occurrence is evicted.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.exceptions.max-occurrences-per-group
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of recent occurrences retained per exception group.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.exceptions.max-stack-frames
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of stack-trace frames retained per exception (and per cause).

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.expose-values
propertySuggestions.description: How configuration values are exposed in the Config panel.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.fault-tolerance.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether BootUI subscribes to the fault tolerance libraries' own event publishers and listeners. When {@code false}, declared policies are still listed but no outcome is captured and no {@code FAULT_TOLERANCE} entry reaches Live Activity.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.fault-tolerance.max-events
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of captured fault tolerance outcomes retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.force-web
propertySuggestions.description: While BootUI is active, force a non-web (command-line) application into a servlet web application so the BootUI console can be served. Has no effect on applications that are already servlet web applications or that are explicitly configured as reactive. Set to false to leave the host application's web-application type untouched.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.free-on-idle.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether BootUI releases its live in-memory diagnostic buffers (captured SQL, ingested traces, and the request/security correlation windows) after the console has been idle for {@code timeout}, and stops recording into them until the console is used again. The Exceptions and Log Tail buffers are kept so a recent error is still visible when you open the console. Has no effect in production, where BootUI is inactive.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.free-on-idle.timeout
propertySuggestions.description: How long the console may go without any request before its live buffers are released. The timer resets on every BootUI request (loading the UI, API polling, or opening a stream), so an open console never reclaims; only a genuinely unused one does. Clamped to a minimum of one second.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.allowed-api-hosts
propertySuggestions.description: Additional allowed GitHub API hosts. GitHub.com is allowed by default.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.api-enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Allow the GitHub panel refresh action to call GitHub APIs.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.max-api-calls
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of GitHub API calls issued by one refresh.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.max-issues
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum issues returned in one dashboard refresh.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.max-pull-requests
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum pull requests returned in one dashboard refresh.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.max-security-alerts
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum Dependabot alert details listed in one dashboard refresh. The alert count is still exact; only the inlined detail list is capped. Code scanning and secret scanning remain count-only and never inline alert details.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.max-workflow-runs
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum workflow runs returned in one dashboard refresh.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.quota-safety-threshold
propertySuggestions.description: Safety threshold below which optional GitHub calls are skipped.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.github.request-timeout
propertySuggestions.description: Timeout applied to each GitHub API request and local credential lookup.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.graalvm.max-repository-lookups
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of distinct dependency coordinates looked up against the reachability metadata repository in a single scan.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.graalvm.repository-lookup-enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Allow the GraalVM dependency survey to look up Oracle's GraalVM reachability metadata repository for per-version coverage of classpath dependencies. The lookup is the panel's only outbound network call and is performed only during a user-initiated dependency scan.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.graalvm.repository-lookup-timeout
propertySuggestions.description: Timeout applied to each reachability metadata repository request.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.heap-dump.allow-raw-download
propertySuggestions.description: Allow downloading the raw {@code .hprof} file over HTTP. Disabled by default because the raw dump contains unmasked secrets.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.heap-dump.capture-enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Allow on-demand heap dump capture. When {@code false}, the panel still exposes the live class histogram analysis but the capture endpoint is rejected.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.heap-dump.max-classes
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of classes retained in memory after a histogram analysis, ordered by retained bytes. Capping this value prevents very large heaps from exhausting memory. Must be ≥ {@code top-classes}.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.heap-dump.max-dumps
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of heap dump files retained on disk. Oldest dumps are deleted first.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.heap-dump.output-dir
propertySuggestions.description: Directory where captured heap dumps are written.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.heap-dump.top-classes
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of classes returned in the class histogram, ordered by retained bytes.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.http-exchanges.max-exchanges
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of HTTP exchanges retained in the in-memory repository.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.http-sessions.max-sessions
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of active HTTP sessions returned by the HTTP Sessions panel.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.jms.capture-message-id
propertySuggestions.description: Whether a provider-assigned JMS message ID is retained as a truncated SHA-256 hash. The raw message ID is never stored.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.jms.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether BootUI captures {@link org.springframework.jms.core.JmsTemplate} sends and {@code @JmsListener} deliveries into the Live Activity stream as {@code MESSAGING} entries. When {@code false}, no JMS bean is post-processed. Only takes effect when {@code spring-jms} is on the classpath.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.jms.max-entries
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of JMS messages retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.jms.max-message-id-length
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum retained length of the JMS message ID's hex-encoded SHA-256 hash.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.kafka.capture-key
propertySuggestions.description: Whether a SHA-256 hash of the message key is retained alongside each captured entry (truncated to {@link #maxKeyLength}). The raw key is never retained. On by default since a Kafka key is typically a correlation/partitioning id rather than a secret, but this lets an application disable even the hash when its keys carry sensitive data. The message value/payload is never captured at all.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.kafka.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Whether BootUI captures {@code KafkaTemplate} sends and {@code @KafkaListener} deliveries into the Live Activity stream as {@code MESSAGING} entries. When {@code false}, no {@code KafkaTemplate}/listener container factory bean is post-processed. Only takes effect when {@code spring-kafka} is on the classpath.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.kafka.max-entries
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of captured messages retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.kafka.max-key-length
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum retained length of the message key's hex-encoded SHA-256 hash.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.log-tail.max-bytes
propertySuggestions.description: Approximate retained-byte budget for the in-memory Log Tail ring buffer, bounding it alongside its fixed line cap (oldest evicted first when either bound trips). {@code 0} (the default) means unbounded — preserving the Spring adapter's historical behaviour — and matches the Quarkus adapter's {@code bootui.log-tail.max-bytes} default, so the same key sizes the buffer identically on both frameworks.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mask-secrets
propertySuggestions.description: Mask secret-like configuration values.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mcp.enabled
propertySuggestions.description: Initial state of the local MCP server. {@link Mode#OFF} by default (fail closed); {@link Mode#ON} starts the server enabled. {@link Mode#AUTO} is treated the same as {@link Mode#OFF} so the server is never silently exposed. The MCP Server panel can override this at runtime.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mcp.execution-timeout
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum wall-clock duration of one MCP tool invocation; default 30 seconds.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mcp.max-concurrent-calls
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of concurrent MCP tool invocations; default 20. Excess requests get a JSON-RPC error immediately.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mcp.max-payload-bytes
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum request payload bytes; default 1MB. Requests exceeding this are rejected before parsing.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mcp.max-response-bytes
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum rendered JSON-RPC response size; default 4MB.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mcp.max-results
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum number of items returned by paginated read tools (config, beans, mappings, security logs, traces, HTTP exchanges) in a single call.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.monitoring.exclude-self
propertySuggestions.description: Hide BootUI's own runtime data from monitoring panels.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-indexes
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum index activity rows per datasource. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-lock-waits
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum lock-wait observations per datasource. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-replication-channels
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum local replication channels per datasource. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-sessions
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum session rows per datasource; positive and below 2147483647. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-settings
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum displayed settings from the fixed allow-list. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-statements
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum normalized statements ranked by total execution time. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.mysql.max-tables
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum table rows per datasource. Requires restart.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.overrides-file
propertySuggestions.description: Where local runtime overrides are persisted.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.panels
propertySuggestions.description: Per-panel visibility and action settings keyed by panel id.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.path
propertySuggestions.description: UI base path. Must be an absolute path (starting with {@code /}), not {@code /}, and must not contain path-traversal, query, or fragment components. Trailing slashes are stripped. The API path is automatically derived as {@code path + "/api"} unless {@code bootui.api-path} is also set.

propertySuggestions.name: bootui.postgresql.max-indexes

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.mode
propertySuggestions.description: Determine when the task executor is to be created.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.pool.allow-core-thread-timeout
propertySuggestions.description: Whether core threads are allowed to time out. This enables dynamic growing and shrinking of the pool. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.pool.core-size
propertySuggestions.description: Core number of threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.pool.keep-alive
propertySuggestions.description: Time limit for which threads may remain idle before being terminated. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.pool.max-size
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum allowed number of threads. If tasks are filling up the queue, the pool can expand up to that size to accommodate the load. Ignored if the queue is unbounded. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.pool.queue-capacity
propertySuggestions.description: Queue capacity. An unbounded capacity does not increase the pool and therefore ignores the "max-size" property. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.pool.shutdown.accept-tasks-after-context-close
propertySuggestions.description: Whether to accept further tasks after the application context close phase has begun.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.propagate-context
propertySuggestions.description: Whether to propagate the current context to task executions.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.shutdown.await-termination
propertySuggestions.description: Whether the executor should wait for scheduled tasks to complete on shutdown.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.shutdown.await-termination-period
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum time the executor should wait for remaining tasks to complete.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.simple.cancel-remaining-tasks-on-close
propertySuggestions.description: Whether to cancel remaining tasks on close. Only recommended if threads are commonly expected to be stuck.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.simple.concurrency-limit
propertySuggestions.description: Set the maximum number of parallel accesses allowed. -1 indicates no concurrency limit at all.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.simple.reject-tasks-when-limit-reached
propertySuggestions.description: Whether to reject tasks when the concurrency limit has been reached.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.execution.thread-name-prefix
propertySuggestions.description: Prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.scheduling.pool.size
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum allowed number of threads. Doesn't have an effect if virtual threads are enabled.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.scheduling.shutdown.await-termination
propertySuggestions.description: Whether the executor should wait for scheduled tasks to complete on shutdown.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.scheduling.shutdown.await-termination-period
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum time the executor should wait for remaining tasks to complete.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.scheduling.simple.concurrency-limit
propertySuggestions.description: Set the maximum number of parallel accesses allowed. -1 indicates no concurrency limit at all.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.task.scheduling.thread-name-prefix
propertySuggestions.description: Prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.threads.virtual.enabled

propertySuggestions.description: Whether to enable default resource handling.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.cache-private
propertySuggestions.description: Indicate that the response message is intended for a single user and must not be stored by a shared cache.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.cache-public
propertySuggestions.description: Indicate that any cache may store the response.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.max-age
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum time the response should be cached, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.must-revalidate
propertySuggestions.description: Indicate that once it has become stale, a cache must not use the response without re-validating it with the server.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.no-cache
propertySuggestions.description: Indicate that the cached response can be reused only if re-validated with the server.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.no-store
propertySuggestions.description: Indicate to not cache the response in any case.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.no-transform
propertySuggestions.description: Indicate intermediaries (caches and others) that they should not transform the response content.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.proxy-revalidate
propertySuggestions.description: Same meaning as the "must-revalidate" directive, except that it does not apply to private caches.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.s-max-age
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum time the response should be cached by shared caches, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.stale-if-error
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum time the response may be used when errors are encountered, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol.stale-while-revalidate
propertySuggestions.description: Maximum time the response can be served after it becomes stale, in seconds if no duration suffix is not specified.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.period
propertySuggestions.description: Cache period for the resources served by the resource handler. If a duration suffix is not specified, seconds will be used. Can be overridden by the 'spring.web.resources.cache.cachecontrol' properties.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.cache.use-last-modified
propertySuggestions.description: Whether we should use the "lastModified" metadata of the files in HTTP caching headers.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.chain.strategy.content.paths

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.chain.strategy.fixed.paths
propertySuggestions.description: List of patterns to apply to the fixed Version Strategy.

propertySuggestions.name: spring.web.resources.chain.strategy.fixed.version
propertySuggestions.description: Version string to use for the fixed Version Strategy.
